notes: Versions/features verified against official crate documentation, registry metadata and fetched upstream Cargo source. Cargo.lock pins transitive versions and checksums.
This ledger is not an advisory clearance or license/SBOM acceptance. Those gates remain pending.
serde-saphyr avoids abandoned serde_yaml and does not enable filesystem include extensions.
Official 2026-08-20 arrayref supply-chain incident packages/versions are absent from this lockfile; check again when adding dependencies.

C2/C3 pins were verified against current official crates.io metadata and fetched upstream source. rusqlite bundled+backup+hooks selects libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2 / SQLite 3.53.2; ENABLE_FTS5 is set by upstream build.rs and a synthetic external-content query passes.

Expanded Windows check reaches native SQLite compilation but cannot find MSVC lib.exe in the Linux executor. Native CI toolchains are required; earlier pure-Rust C1 cross-target passes do not cover the new native dependency.

Chrono is pinned with std,clock and default-features=false. Shared helpers preserve Go seconds/nanosecond precision and runtime-local offset; routine IANA timezone scheduling is a separate integration.

toolchain_security.assessment: The advisory applies to pre-1.96 Cargo using third-party registries. This locked build uses crates.io only, which the official advisory explicitly excludes; no alternate registry is configured. Reassess before changing registry sources.
